ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Limited has officially extinguished 825,028 equity shares, with a face value of ₹2 each, which were repurchased through an open market buyback completed in August 2026. This action reduces the total outstanding shares, thereby positively impacting the Earnings Per Share (EPS) for existing shareholders. The document confirms compliance with SEBI Buy-Back Regulations, and no immediate red flags are apparent.
